threshold.quote: The model removes existing bottlenecks to scaling cyber operations including by automating end-to-end cyber operations against reasonably hardened targets

response.quote: We will require the following practices for High capability models:

acc_decider.quote: Making all final decisions, including accepting any residual risks and making deployment go/no-go decisions, informed by SAG’s recommendations.
acc_decider.note: OpenAI Leadership (the CEO or a designee); SAG recommends and the Board's SSC may reverse a decision.

acc_external.quote: Independent Security Audits: Ensure security controls and practices are validated regularly by third-party auditors to ensure compliance with relevant standards and robustness against identified threats.
acc_external.note: Covers the C.3 security controls required at High. Third-party capability evaluation and stress testing (p.14) are conditioned on 'If we deem' and 'when available and feasible', so not counted.

acc_unmet.note: Framework-wide noncompliance procedure (investigation). Also Table 1 (p.6) 'halt further development' for Critical until safeguards are specified.
